company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, founder-led transportation and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It operates long-distance bus services and is expanding into passenger rail across Central Europe. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own booking platform, network planning and travel brand; technology supports online booking, trip tracking and other travel services.

The company describes itself as engineering-led and technology-first, with teams that own their systems end to end. Scaling data and machine-learning capabilities is a strategic priority. Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own, and Enjoy the journey**, reflected in an emphasis on ownership, career development, sustainability and solving problems collaboratively.

Corvale highlights international teams working toward shared goals and a fast-moving, open-to-ideas culture. Workplace awards based on employee feedback have recognized innovation, flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. Some employees work hybrid, and technology roles may also be open to independent contractors.

results.title: About Corvale Mobility
results.content: Corvale Mobility runs long-distance buses and a growing passenger-rail service in Central Europe. It uses an asset-light model: regional partners operate many routes while Corvale runs the booking platform, network planning and brand. Corvale has ordered a new train fleet to enter service later this decade, and scaling data and machine-learning use across the platform is a strategic priority.
